notes: Phase 2 of crop-overlay-swap-all-layouts plan: implemented 'Swap in All Layouts' feature. Three sub-phases: (1) PanelSwap refactoring — renamed HexPanelSwap.js → PanelSwap.js, createHexDragHandler → createPanelSwapHandler, removed LayoutStyle.HEXAGONAL guard so swap works in all layouts, added _multiTouchGestureActive guard. (2) Pointer coordination — removed pointerdown from GestureHandler (swap handler now handles click-to-select via pointerup), added _multiTouchGestureActive flag to MultiTouchHandler (set on gesture start, cleared on end/cancel/blur/detach), removed hex guard from MultiTouchHandler. (3) State + rendering rename — hexDragTargetId → dragTargetId, drawHexDragTarget → drawDragTarget, updated all 4 source files and 5 test files. Added setPointerCapture to PanelSwapHandler per world-review. Created new PanelSwapTest.html with 19 tests (swap in all layouts, multi-touch guard, click-to-select, drag-and-drop). Updated MultiTouchHandlerTest.html with 7 new gesture-active flag tests. All 718 tests pass (1 pre-existing SaliencyDebugOverlayTest failure unrelated to changes). Updated building-web-apps skill references for pointer handler coordination pattern.
